cohort: 680 pregnant women diagnosed with severe anemia
finding: The prevalence of severe anemia in pregnancy was 4.4%, and severe anemia was associated with adverse maternal outcomes (preterm labor, preeclampsia/eclampsia, sepsis, wound gape) and fetal outcomes (LBW, IUGR, prematurity, birth asphyxia, IUD/stillbirth).
birth_weight: LBW babies were included in the study, but no specific weight range was provided.
